paraphrase: Sit with the body upright, neither leaning nor slumped, ears in line with shoulders, nose with navel; let go of all involvements; do not think of good or evil; when a thought arises, be aware of it; when aware of it, it vanishes; long practice forgets objects and one becomes unified; seated meditation is the Dharma gate of ease and joy.
speaker: Changlu Zongze
notes: From memory; no local text; no original given.
